entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 421-aa soluble enzyme sequence; predicted molecular mass 48.3 kDa and pI 5.50.
Contains Pfam Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26; residues 82–346) and KYNU_C (PF22580.3; residues 329–415).
Shares 70.6–72.0% identity and ~99.5% query coverage with reviewed bacterial kynureninases A0M4Y1, A5FMM4, and A6H1P7.
Strong homology-based assignment to pyridoxal 5'-phosphate-dependent kynureninase; exact substrate preference remains inferred from homologs.

entities.name: Kynureninase A0M4Y1
observations: Reviewed UniProt kynureninase from Christiangramia forsetii; EC 3.7.1.3.
Uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate and is annotated as a homodimer.
Catalyzes cleavage of L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine, and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine.

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Rhea RHEA:16813: L-kynurenine + H2O = anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+).
This is the principal inferred reaction for the query sequence based on near-full-length similarity to reviewed kynureninases.

entities.name: 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: This secondary substrate reaction is supported by the same reviewed kynurenase homolog annotations.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: ChEBI:CHEBI:597326; curated kynureninase homologs annotate PLP as the required cofactor and contain a covalent PLP-lysine feature.
